name: x2611_15379_lem2_1
statement: (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → ℕ) (H : Fin m → ℕ → ℂ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hcop : Pairwise (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (q i) (q j))) (hnz : ∀ i n, 0 < n → H i n ≠ 0) (hperiod : ∀ i, IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (H i) (n + T) = (H i) n} (q i)) : IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i : Fin m, H i n) (n + T) = (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i : Fin m, H i n) n} (∏ i : Fin m, q i)
closed: ∀ (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → ℕ) (H : Fin m → ℕ → ℂ) (hq : ∀ i, 0 < q i) (hcop : Pairwise (fun i j => Nat.Coprime (q i) (q j))) (hnz : ∀ i n, 0 < n → H i n ≠ 0) (hperiod : ∀ i, IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (H i) (n + T) = (H i) n} (q i)), IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i : Fin m, H i n) (n + T) = (fun n : ℕ => ∏ i : Fin m, H i n) n} (∏ i : Fin m, q i)
original: Let $q_{1},q_{2},\ldots,q_{m}$ be pairwise coprime positive integers. For each $1\leq i\leq m$ , let $H_{i}:\mathbb{Z}^{+}\rightarrow\mathbb{C}\backslash\{0\}$ have least positive period $q_{i}$ . Then the function $H(n)=\prod\limits_{i=1}^{m}H_{i}(n)$ has least positive period $\prod\limits_{i=1}^{m}q_{i}$ .
type: ∀ (m : ℕ) (q : Fin m → ℕ) (H : Fin m → ℕ → ℂ), (∀ (i : Fin m), 0 < q i) → (Pairwise fun i j => (q i).Coprime (q j)) → (∀ (i : Fin m) (n : ℕ), 0 < n → H i n ≠ 0) → (∀ (i : Fin m), IsLeast {T | 0 < T ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → H i (n + T) = H i n} (q i)) → IsLeast {T | 0 < T ∧ ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → (fun n => ∏ i, H i n) (n + T) = (fun n => ∏ i, H i n) n} (∏ i, q i)
